gloss: to overwhelm; to overpower; to dominate

definitions.gloss: to overwhelm; to overpower; to dominate
definitions.explanation: To surpass or defeat decisively by having far greater power, skill, numbers, or intensity. Often used in passive form to express being overwhelmed.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}チームを{圧倒|あっとう}した。
その{演奏|えんそう}に{圧倒|あっとう}された。
examples.english: I was overwhelmed by the performance.

examples.japanese: {圧倒的|あっとうてき}な{実力|じつりょく}{差|さ}で{優勝|ゆうしょう}チームが{決勝|けっしょう}を{制|せい}した。
examples.english: The champion team won the final with an overwhelming difference in ability.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in the passive form {圧倒|あっとう}される (to be overwhelmed). The derived adjective {圧倒的|あっとうてき} (overwhelming) is extremely common and often more frequently used than the verb itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {圧倒|あっとう}される (to be overwhelmed)
- {圧倒的|あっとうてき}な (overwhelming)
- {圧倒的|あっとうてき}な{勝利|しょうり} (overwhelming victory)
- {圧倒的|あっとうてき}な{多数|たすう} (overwhelming majority)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {制圧|せいあつ}する: to suppress, to overpower — more forceful, military nuance
- {凌駕|りょうが}する: to surpass, to outstrip — focuses on exceeding rather than defeating
- {打|う}ち{負|ま}かす: to defeat, to beat — more colloquial
